findings.body: New evidence beyond the prior ruling/fix: `coversWholeCalendarMonths` is applied without checking the window column. Consequently, a `posting_date` window from `2026-07-01` through `2026-07-31` with no `periodControl` is still rendered as `July 2026`, even though the ruling permits month-name collapsing only for same-month windows on the `month` column and requires other windows to retain exact date wording. This affects both the readout and empty-state message. Restrict month collapsing to `window.column === "month"` and add a full-calendar `posting_date` case alongside the partial-range leaves.
findings.title: Preserve exact full-month ranges for non-month columns
